name: Subroto Bagchi
about:
Subroto Bagchi is an entrepreneur, author and public servant. 

Bagchi spent four decades with the Indian IT industry where he is best known as a co-founder of Mindtree. Mindtree (now LTIMindtree) was one of India’s most admired software companies that built the AADHAR platform among its many other contributions. In 2019, Mindtree revenues exceeded US $1 billion with 20,000 employees globally. Bagchi started at Mindtree as Chief Operating Officer in 1999 and rose to become Executive Chairman before stepping down in 2016 when he moved to public service. 

Bagchi is a well-known writer with best-sellers like The High-Performance Entrepreneur, Go Kiss the World, The Professional, MBA at 16, The Elephant Catchers and SELL. His last book SELL received the CK Prahalad Award for the best business book of 2018. His books have been translated in many major Indian languages as well as Chinese and Korean. 

As a public servant, his last assignment was Chief Advisor to Government of Odisha for Institutional Capacity Building. Prior to this, he was Chairman of Odisha Skill Development Authority where his charter was to create employable skills for youth of Odisha through short and long-term skill building. Under his leadership, the State witnessed massive transformation of the ITI and Polytechnics as well as scaling up of short-term skill development. His largest contribution has been the setting up of the iconic World Skill Center in Bhubaneswar. The Government of Odisha accorded him with the rank and status of cabinet minister. He took a salary of 1 Rupee per year from the Government for his eight years of service from 2016 to 2024. 

Bagchi has been inducted into the Order of Engineers by the University of Florida and honoured for his contributions in Management and Information Technology by the Utkal University with an Honorary Doctorate in Literature and by the Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology with an Honorary Doctorate in Science. 

Bagchi has served the boards of IIM Bengaluru, Indian Oil, IIIT Bhubaneswar and the Software Technology Parks of India. He and his writer wife Susmita, support the cause for prevention of blindness, geriatric care, cancer, and mental health among other issues towards which they have pledged substantial personal wealth and time. Their efforts have led to the setting up of the Bagchi-Parthasarathy Hospital at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, the Bagchi-Sri Shankara Cancer Hospital & Research Centre in Bhubaneswar, and the Bagchi-Karunashraya Centre for Palliative Care in Bhubaneswar and The Bagchi School of Public Health at the Ahmedabad University.
organisation: Vision Group for Skill Development, Govt. of Karnataka

name: Dr. Gururaj 'Desh' Deshpande
about: Dr. Gururaj "Desh" Deshpande is a renowned Indian-American entrepreneur, philanthropist, and ecosystem builder. Over a four-decade entrepreneurial career, he has founded and chaired several major technology companies, including Cascade Communications (which routed over 80% of internet traffic in the 1990s), Sycamore Networks, and Tejas Networks. He also co-chaired US President Obama’s National Council on Innovation and Entrepreneurship. Desh serves as a Life Member of the MIT Corporation, where he established the Deshpande Center for Technological Innovation. Alongside his wife, Jaishree, Desh launched the Deshpande Foundation to co-create scalable models for social transformation across India, the United States, and Canada. In 2007, the couple established the Deshpande Centre for Social Innovation in their hometown of Hubballi in north Karnataka. Through this ecosystem, they have supported more than 521 startups, generated over ₹1,061 crore in cumulative revenue, built 15,000 farm ponds for dryland farmers and trained 26,000+ disadvantaged youth - achieving an 80% formal employment rate. Additionally, their primary education program nurtures over 40,000 children across 600 rural schools with essential life skills. The Foundation now drives systemic change by partnering with public universities to embed employability skills directly into higher education.

name: Dr. R. Balasubramaniam
about: Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, popularly known as Dr. Balu, is a widely respected development practitioner, leadership trainer, author, and public policy expert. He also serves as Chairperson of the Social Stock Exchange Advisory Committee of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). He brings to this role a rare blend of grassroots and macro perspectives, drawn from nearly four decades of multifaceted experience in development and public policy. Dr. Balu is widely recognised for his pioneering work with tribal and rural communities in Karnataka. In 1984, he founded the Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement (SVYM), a development organisation whose interventions in health, education, livelihoods, and community empowerment reach over three million people. In 2011, he founded the Grassroots Research and Advocacy Movement (GRAAM) to bridge the gap between grassroots realities and public policy through evidence-based research and advocacy. Prior to joining NITI Aayog, he served as Member (Human Resources) of the Capacity Building Commission from April 2021 to April 2026, where he played a key role in advancing civil services capacity building and public sector human resource reforms. He was the Frank H. T. Rhodes Professor at Cornell University, USA, from 2012 to 2014, and continued his association with Cornell University as a Visiting Professor and Faculty Affiliate until 2024. Dr. Balu holds a PhD in Leadership and Management. He was awarded the Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa) by Nrupatunga University, Government of Karnataka, in recognition of his contributions to social development and his work with rural and tribal communities. He earned a Master of Public Administration from John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University where he was a Mason Fellow. He also holds an MPhil in Hospital and Health Systems Management and an MBBS. His academic background reflects an interdisciplinary foundation spanning medicine, public administration, systems management, leadership, and social development.

name: N.S. Parthasarathy
about:
Parthasarathy NS (Partha) is a seasoned entrepreneur, investor, and technology leader with a distinguished career spanning over four decades in the global IT industry. As the co-founder, COO, and Executive Vice-Chairperson of Mindtree, he played a pivotal role in transforming the company from a VC-funded startup in 1999 to a billion-dollar enterprise by 2019.

Partha’s expertise lies in scaling technology businesses, executing successful M&A strategies, and fostering high-performance, high-caring organizational cultures. His leadership was instrumental in establishing Mindtree’s globally recognized learning center in Bhubaneswar—designed around the principles of Curiosity, Courage, and Responsibility, setting new benchmarks in talent development.

An angel investor and mentor, Partha actively supports startups in technology, strategy, organizational culture, and enterprise sales. He has personally invested in several startups and is a limited partner in funds such as Inventus and TVS Capital. His passion for nurturing sustainable businesses is encapsulated in his belief:

“We started off with a very simple goal—to help people create 10 more Mindtrees. If we achieve even a part of that, it will be a legacy worth leaving behind.”

A recipient of the Distinguished Alumnus Award from BITS Pilani, Partha holds an M.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Kharagpur and has completed the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School. Beyond his corporate achievements, he is a passionate marathoner and an active member of various social impact initiatives, including the India Amateur Runners Trust and WeLive Foundation.

name: Hiroshi Nawata
about: Born in Nagano, Japan, on September 8, 1963, he began his diplomatic career with Japan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1986. Over four decades, he has developed wide-ranging experience in international diplomacy and bilateral relations. His distinguished overseas assignments have taken him to the United States, Indonesia, Australia, Papua New Guinea, and Slovakia. At the Ministry, he held senior positions in regional affairs, international exchange, foreign policy, and gender mainstreaming. He served as Deputy Chief of Mission at the Embassies of Japan in Papua New Guinea and Slovakia. His career reflects a strong commitment to strengthening Japan’s partnerships and people-to-people connections around the world. Since March 2026, he is serving as Consul General of Japan at the Consulate General of Japan in Bengaluru, India.
organisation: Consulate General of Japan in Bengaluru

name: Meena Ganesh
about: Meena is the Co-founder & Chairperson of Portea Medical (www.portea.com), India’s leading home healthcare company, which she co-founded in July 2013. The company, has 3000+ employees and operations across 20+ cities in India, and brings in-home to patients, the full range of geriatric, chronic, post-operative care as well as allied healthcare services. As a partner of the platform, Growthstory.in, one of India’s largest entrepreneurship platforms, she is also co-promoter of nearly a dozen, new-age Internet/ Technology enabled start-ups e.g Bigbasket, Bluestone, HomeLane, and Verloop.io.   Meena’s career spans across organisations such as TutorVista, Pearson Education Services, Tesco Hindustan Service Centre, CustomerAsset, Microsoft India, PWC and NIIT. Meena is a PGDM holder from IIM Calcutta and has a graduate degree in Physics from the Madras University. Meena serves on the boards of Axis Bank, Hitachi Energy India, Pfizer limited Pidilite Industries and Orkla India. In 2024 she stepped off the board of Procter and Gamble Health and Hygiene Limited after completing her term. At Axis Bank she serves as the chair of the NRC, and is a member of the Audit committee, M&A committee and the CSR committee. She is earlier served as chair of the IT & security committee. In March 2025, she was awarded the Best Women Independent director for the year 2023-24 by the Asian Center for corporate governance and sustainability. She has been part of the Board of Governors of the Indian Institute of Management-Calcutta. Through her non-profit Bahaar Foundation, Meena focuses on creating micro entrepreneurs in Healthcare and Agriculture sectors. Meena has been recognized by Forbes Asia – 50 Over 50 (2022) for and also featured in the list of Top 20 Outstanding Female Business Leaders by Forbes Asia 2021. She has been part of Fortune India’s 50 'Most Powerful Women in Business' for seven consecutive years (2015 - 2021). She has also been featured on IFC WeRise: Insights from Women Business Leaders on Managing through Crisis, Resilience and Recovery in 2021, also recognized by Business Today as Most Powerful Women in Business (2019-2023) and on W PowerTrailblazer by Forbes India in 2017 to acknowledge the significant achievements being made by women across diverse sectors. She won Acharya /Business Mentor of the Year by Entrepreneur India (2019), Pride of Karnataka Awards by Round Table India and Ladies Circle India (2017) and the ET Start-up Award in the Women Ahead category in 2016 and was chosen as Health Entrepreneur of the Year (2016) at the India Health Summit & Awards. She was awarded the Kempegowda Award by BBMP for contribution to the city of Bengaluru.

name: Siegfried Leffler
about: Mr Siegfried Leffler is the Director of Global Operations at GIZ International Services, with more than 25 years of international leadership experience spanning international cooperation, public policy, and business. He leads global operations and business development, translating strategic priorities into partnerships and opportunities across diverse markets. His experience spans business development, operational leadership and strategic positioning, with expertise in EU and international development frameworks, private-sector cooperation and the growing role of private capital in achieving sustainable development objectives. He has held senior leadership positions across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, including GIZ Country Director in Ghana and Principal Representative to the EU in Brussels. He is fluent in German, English, and French, with working knowledge of Arabic.

name: P. N. Nayak
about: P. N. Nayak is a visionary leader with over three decades of experience driving systemic transformation in education, talent development, and youth employability. Prior to his current role, he has held leadership positions at HCL Infosystems and HCL Hewlett Packard. At Deshpande Skilling, P. N. Nayak commands large-scale initiatives that bridge the gap between academia and industry, empowering youth and children across the higher education and school ecosystems. Over 25,000 rural youth have been skilled and over 80% placed in sustainable employment in the formal sector. Additionally, he steers the organization's Skill in Village program which has infused confidence and aspiration in 40,000 children across 500+ rural vernacular medium schools in 5 states of India.

name: Dr. Vivek Raghavan
about: Dr. Vivek Raghavan is an entrepreneur, technologist and builder of digital public infrastructure. Vivek co-founded Sarvam because of his belief that Generative AI has potential to impact the lives of all Indians. Vivek has had the privilege of being part of many population scale initiatives over the past decade and a half. Vivek played a key role in the design, implementation and scale out of the technology platform forAadhaar, the world’s largest identity program. More recently, Vivek was Chief Mentor to AI4Bharat and advisor to Bhashini to build open source datasets, models and benchmarks in Indian languages. Vivek holds an M.S. and Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Carnegie Mellon University and a B. Tech. from IIT Delhi.

name: Alina Alam
about: Alina Alam is a social entrepreneur, disability inclusion advocate, and the Founder-CEO of Mitti Café, an organisation working to create economic independence, dignity, and equal opportunities for persons with disabilities. She founded Mitti Café at the age of 23, driven by a vision to showcase the abilities and potential of individuals with disabilities and create workplaces where inclusion is embedded in everyday life. Alina holds a B.A. in Psychology from Sophia College for Women, Mumbai, and a Master’s degree in Development Studies from Azim Premji University, Bengaluru. Her academic background in psychology and development studies has strongly shaped her approach to social entrepreneurship, community development, and inclusive employment. Under her leadership, Mitti Café has grown from a single table under an umbrella into a nationally recognised social enterprise, with cafés operating across India, including at prestigious institutions such as the Supreme Court of India, Rashtrapati Bhavan, airports, universities, and corporate spaces. The organisation has created thousands of livelihood opportunities for persons with disabilities and also runs outreach initiatives promoting disability awareness, inclusion, and rights. Alina is a four-time TEDx speaker and has been recognised on the Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia list. Her work has received national and international recognition, including the National Award for the Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (2024), presented by the President of India, the Commonwealth Youth Award, NITI Aayog’s Women Transforming India Award, United Nations Intercultural Innovation Award, Helen Keller Award, and several other honours for social entrepreneurship and disability inclusion. Her areas of interest include disability inclusion, inclusive employment, social entrepreneurship, community development, accessibility, youth leadership, and building sustainable models for social impact. Through her work, Alina seeks to challenge conventional perceptions of disability and inspire a more equitable and inclusive society.

name: Prasanth Balakrishnan Nair (Kirti Chakra)
about: Air Commodore Prasanth Balakrishnan Nair is an Indian Air Force fighter pilot, experimental test pilot, and astronaut with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). A graduate of the National Defence Academy and Air Force Academy, he was commissioned into the IAF in 1998 and has logged nearly 3,000 flying hours across military fighter and transport aircraft. He commanded a frontline Sukhoi-30 MKI squadron and received the Kirti Chakra for gallantry. An alumnus of the Yuri Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Centre, he qualified on the Soyuz spacecraft and served as a backup astronaut for the Axiom-4 mission to the International Space Station.

name: Arati Hiremath
about:
Arati Hiremath has been into business for the past 36 years. She floated Artikrafts in the year 1990. Arati Hiremath is an exponent of Kasuti embroidery. She started reviving Kasuti when it was almost a languishing craft. She has experimented with its application on different wearables and home décor and has made it a popular Indian embroidery. She markets it throughout the world through her Facebook and Instagram pages and her website, www.artikrafts.in. She has a studio in Dharwad and has formed a formidable customer base.

She also engages in training programmes and helps students and scholars in their research on Kasuti. So far, she has trained hundreds of women in the craft of Kasuti embroidery. She has more than 200 artisans working for Artikrafts.

She has attended various exhibitions, but the feather in the cap was exhibiting at the G20 Finance Summit in Bengaluru. Amongst her known customers is Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman, the Hon. Minister of Finance, who wore an Artikrafts creation to present the 2023 Budget and another one to her daughter’s wedding.

She has also created a shalya which was presented to Hon. Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi during the inauguration of the National Youth Festival held at Hubli.

She was presented an award for her work in the field of crafts by Sri Sathya Sai University of Human Excellence. She was among seven women from all over India to be honoured with this award.

She is happily married to Praveen Hiremath, an engineer by profession, who is into business.

Her daughter, Tanushree, and son-in-law are dental surgeons in Mumbai.

Her son, Shivharan, is a businessman.

name: Dr. Arun Yogiraj
about: Dr. Arun Yogiraj is one of India’s renowned sculptors, representing five generations of Mysore’s traditional sculpting heritage. With an MBA from the University of Mysore, he returned to sculpting in 2008 after a brief corporate career. His notable creations include the Ram Lalla idol at Ayodhya’s Ram Mandir, Adi Shankaracharya statue at Kedarnath, Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose statue at India Gate, Nandi at Amarnath, and major works for ISRO and heritage institutions. His sculptures combine traditional Indian aesthetics, realism, spirituality, and intricate craftsmanship. He has received numerous national, state, and international awards and continues to contribute to India’s sculptural heritage.

name: Dr. Ananthalakshmi Venkitaraman
about: Dr. Ananthalakshmi (AL) is a social entrepreneur, researcher, corporate leader, and disability inclusion strategist who founded EquiBeing Foundation with a singular vision, to build an India where blindness is never a barrier to education, opportunity, dignity, and independent living. Combining over two decades of executive leadership across multinational corporations, doctoral research on blind achievers in India, and her own lived experience of progressive vision loss, Dr. Al has emerged as a nationally recognised leader advancing systemic change for persons with visual impairments. Rather than building isolated programmes, she has focused on building institutions, partnerships, evidence, and ecosystems that create lasting transformation.

name: Anna Kuhnt
about:
Anna Kuhnt
Founder & CEO, Quadrigo Pvt. Ltd. | Co-Founder & President, Expat Business Council

Anna Kuhnt is a German entrepreneur, education leader, and certified Neurolanguage Coach with extensive international experience. Having held leadership positions at the Goethe-Institut and worked with the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD), she combines institutional expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to education and skills development. As Founder and CEO of Quadrigo Pvt. Ltd. and Co-Founder and President of the Expat Business Council in Bangalore, she advocates for brain-friendly learning, intercultural competence, innovative leadership, and lifelong learning to prepare individuals for an evolving global workforce.
organisation: Quadrigo Pvt. Ltd, / Expat Business Council

name: Ankush Sabharwal
about:
Ankush Sabharwal, an award-winning tech entrepreneur and founder of CoRover.ai, is leading an innovative journey, steering the best Human-Centric Conversational Agentic AI Platform that has benefited over 1 billion users. He spearheaded the groundbreaking initiative behind BharatGPT, India’s first  Sovereign AI Foundational Model. Ankush’s mission is to harness technology to transform businesses and enrich human lives. Honored as Innovator of the Year (2024), Entrepreneur of the Year, and recognized among the Top 10 AI Influencers globally, Graham Bell Award Winner, National Award Winner, and Governor Award Winner, Ankush brings over two decades of profound IT experience spanning India, America, and Europe. His academic pursuits include an MS in Software Engineering from
BITS, Pilani, complemented by an MBA and executive financial, AI, and
entrepreneurial programs from IIM Calcutta, MIT, and Stanford respectively, reflecting his commitment to excellence in both technology and business realms.

name: Amit Mannan
about: Mr. Mannan leads the cutting-edge initiatives across next-generation telecommunications, 5G/6G systems, and network intelligence, and brings extensive industry leadership to discussions on advanced network technologies and digital infrastructure. Mr. Mannan also leads the CSR initiatives with a focus on education, including the flagship Samsung Innovation Campus program, which empowers youth with industry-ready skills in AI, IoT, coding, and big data.
designation: Vice President and Head of the Network Team

name: Ashish Labroo
about: Ashish Labroo is Business Head at BorderPlus, an AI-native healthcare workforce mobility platform that trains and places Indian nurses and healthcare professionals in Germany, Japan and the GCC. He leads BorderPlus's India business and its expansion into new corridors, including Japan, and builds partnerships with governments and skilling institutions. He has 15+ years of experience across OYO, Jio, Airtel and HDFC, including heading supply, revenue and margins for OYO India, and brings deep expertise in building talent pipelines at scale. Ashish is an alumnus of IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Bindu Ajit
about: Bindu Ajit, Head - Biocon Academy, is a distinguished education leader with over three decades of diverse experience across banking, corporate learning, and life sciences education. She has seamlessly transitioned across sectors, bringing a rich perspective to designing industry-aligned learning ecosystems. At Biocon Academy, she has pioneered innovative, industry-integrated programs that bridge the gap between academic knowledge and real-world application, enabling graduates to become workforce-ready professionals. An ICF PCC certified coach, she also empowers leaders and learners to realize their potential. Her work is redefining how education, industry, and human potential converge to shape the future of talent.

name: Dr. Chetna Nagpal
about: Dr. Chetna Nagpal is a Qualification Development, Apprenticeship and Internal Quality Assurance specialist with over 17 years of experience in engineering education, vocational training, competency-based assessment and workplace learning. She develops industry-responsive qualifications, micro-credentials, assessment strategies and apprenticeship models aligned with national frameworks and employer needs. Her interests include AI, machine learning, smart manufacturing, and engineering applications, and she has contributed to peer-reviewed publications and registered patents/design innovations.
designation: Apprenticeship Specialist - Engineering Programmes; NQC Qualification & Curriculum Developer
organisation: Abu Dhabi Vocational Education & Training Institute - ADVETI

name: Devashish Dasgupta
about: Devashish leads the Corporate Relations function at Diageo India and is a member of its Executive Committee and the Global Corporate Relations Leadership team. His responsibilities include driving policy advocacy across Regulatory, Tax and Trade related matters, Market Access, Corporate Reputation & Communications and delivering Social Impact in line with the Diageo’s Spirit of Progress ESG action plan. Devashish has almost three decades of experience across diverse sectors including FMCG, Food Service, Information Technology, Infrastructure, Media and Automobiles. His experience includes government affairs, policy advocacy, sustainability and CSR. Before joining Diageo, Devashish led the Corporate Affairs function at Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL). At HUL, Devashish was instrumental in supporting the business strategy across categories and supply chain, through a powerful end to end Corporate Affairs agenda both in States and the Centre. Prior to HUL, Devashish was the Executive Vice President for GSK Consumer Healthcare, India & South Asia. He has held several leadership roles including Country Head of Public Policy at Google India, Director Corporate Relations for Diageo’s business in India and South Asia. Devashish played a critical role in setting up the India operations and was the Managing Director – India and South Asia of APCO Worldwide, a leading International Public Affairs consulting company. He began his career as a Chartered Accountant at Arthur Andersen’s Business Advisory and Taxation Practice and later founded and headed a consulting business for over ten years, assisting multinational companies’ entry and building their Business and Government Affairs strategy for India. Devashish is a member of the National Executive Council of FICCI and Public Affairs Forum of India. An avid marathoner and cyclist, Devashish is a cricket and football enthusiast. He enjoys reading contemporary fiction, sports physiology and psychology, history and current affairs.

name: Dr. Gayathri Vasudevan
about: Dr. Gayathri Vasudevan, Chief Impact Officer at Sambhav Foundation, is a distinguished leader in livelihoods, employment, and social impact. She has worked extensively to empower vulnerable communities through education, employability, entrepreneurship, and sustainable livelihoods. A former professional with the International Labour Organization (ILO), she has been recognized among Business Today’s Top 50 Women in Business (2017), named Forbes India’s Entrepreneur of the Year in Social Business (2018), and received NITI Aayog’s Women Transforming India Award (2021). A TED speaker and published scholar, she holds a PhD in Development Studies and has authored over 30 publications on labour, employment, and gender issues.

name: Gayatri Rao
about: Gayatri Rao is the Founder & CEO of NextGen HealthTech Academy, working at the intersection of healthcare, technology and workforce transformation. With over two decades of experience across Healthcare, HealthTech, Pharma and Biotech, she brings a deep understanding of industry dynamics, talent strategy and evolving workforce needs. Through NextGen, she is building bridges between academia, industry and government to create industry-aligned talent pathways and strengthen India's healthcare and life sciences workforce for the future. Her focus is on translating emerging industry opportunities into meaningful career pathways for India's next generation of talent.

name: Gopal Devanahalli
about: Gopal Devanahalli leads SDN’s skilling initiatives across India, focusing on workforce development and job fulfilment through large-scale programs. He brings over 30 years of leadership experience across IT services, software, BPO, healthcare, education, telecom, and consumer industries. Previously, he served as Group President, Strategy & Business Development at Manipal Education & Medical Group and held CEO roles at MeritTrac and Manipal Education Americas. At Infosys, he led digital transformation and growth as Vice President, Products, Platforms & Solutions and Head of the Telecom Business Unit at Infosys BPO. He holds a PGDM from IIM Calcutta, an M.Sc. (Tech) from BITS Pilani, and a Corporate Director Certificate from Harvard BusinessSchool.

name: Kaushik Mudda
about: Kaushik Mudda is Co-Founder and CEO of Ethereal Machines, an advanced manufacturing deep-tech startup creating precision CNC machines for aerospace, defence, healthcare, and semiconductor industries. A key contributor to Karnataka's workforce strategy, he serves on the Government of Karnataka's Industry Vision 5.0 Group, shaping future-ready skilling ecosystems.

name: Madhuri Dubey
about: Dr. Madhuri Dubey is the Founder-Director of National Skills Network (NSN), a knowledge and capacity-building platform focused on strengthening the education–employability–skills ecosystem through applied learning, research, communication and capacity-building initiatives.

name: Meera Rajeevan
about:
Meera Rajeevan, the Chief Operating Officer (COO) of Vidyadhan, boasts an impressive 22
year tenure in the IT sector, marked by notable achievements in strategic leadership roles 
across various functions. Her journey includes the successful patenting of a groundbreaking 
method titled "Process for Estimation of Large Outsourcing Deals in IT." 
For the past decade, Meera has dedicated herself to breaking the poverty cycle by 
facilitating higher education and nurturing India's bright minds through training and 
mentorship initiatives. She has adeptly constructed a robust ecosystem to expand these 
programs nationwide, forging sponsor networks and harnessing technology for scalability. 
A stalwart advocate for women's empowerment, Meera served on the Managing Committee 
of the Thrissur Management Association, spearheading endeavors to enhance female 
representation in the workforce and entrepreneurship. 
In recognition of her exceptional contributions to higher education, Meera was honored 
with the Teacher Warrior Award 2023 by ScooNews. 
Meera holds an engineering degree from the University of Calicut, complemented by a 
Master's in Management from IMI, Delhi. Additionally, she is certified by the Indian Institute 
of Corporate Affairs and is listed in the Independent Directors Data Bank maintained by the 
Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

name: Mekin Maheshwari
about: A Senior Ashoka Fellow, Mekin Maheshwari is the Founder and CEO of Udhyam Learning Foundation, a non-profit organisation that he established in 2017. On a mission to make India entrepreneurial by building mindsets and 21st-century skills, Udhyam has empowered 4.7 million learners and enabled 50,000+ educators in over 11,500+ government schools and ITIs across 12 states. It has supported over 10,000+ nano-entrepreneurs, enabling cumulative income growth of over ₹36 crore+ through Udhyam Vyapaar. Mekin also co-founded G.A.M.E. (Global Alliance for Mass Entrepreneurship), serves on the boards of TeamLease and Khan Academy India, and has invested in more than 70 start-ups and social enterprises as an angel investor. As an engineering graduate, Mekin was an early leader at Flipkart, building and leading the most impactful technology team in India, eventually becoming the Chief People Officer, leading a 35,000+ team. He brings together corporate leadership and social innovation, and is widely recognised for advancing entrepreneurship as a mindset that creates dignity, expands opportunity, and enables livelihoods at scale.

name: Mohan Lakhamraju
about:
Mohan Lakhamraju is a prominent entrepreneur, visionary education leader, and the Founder and CEO of Great Learning. He also serves as the Chairman of the Great Lakes Institute of Management. A strong advocate for continuous upskilling, Mohan has long recognized the cultural shift toward lifelong learning and has dedicated his career to delivering high-quality, transformational education to millions of professionals worldwide. 

Mohan holds a stellar academic pedigree, having earned his B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Bombay, followed by a Master's in Computer Science from the University of California, Berkeley. A recipient of the prestigious David Packard Fellowship, he went on to complete his MBA at the Stanford Graduate School of Business. 

Before entering the ed-tech space, he spent a decade in Silicon Valley, first as an entrepreneur helping build Stratify (a SaaS company, now part of HP). He then moved into venture capital as an investor at Draper Fisher Jurvetson (DFJ), before going on to serve as Managing Director for Tiger Global in India, where he led the firm's investment activities across high-potential ventures in India and other emerging markets. As Chairman of the Great Lakes Institute of Management, Mohan spearheads the growth strategy and new initiatives. He has been associated with Great Lakes since 2011 and helped expand its range of offerings into new geographies, new executive programs, and technology-enabled online and blended learning programs. 

In 2013, Mohan co-founded Great Learning with a mission to deliver high-quality, blended learning outcomes. Under his leadership, the bootstrapped startup has grown into a leading global online higher education platform, delivering over 500 million hours of impactful learning to more than 15 million professionals across 170+ countries. He has also driven the growth of the Great Lakes Institute of Management as its Chairman — spearheading the establishment of its Gurgaon campus, guiding it to a top-10 ranking among private business schools in India, and leading it to become the youngest business school in the country to earn AMBA (UK) accreditation. Great Lakes today counts an alumni network of over 25,000 professionals across 30+ countries. 

Mohan's contributions to business and education have earned wide recognition, including 'Transformative Edtech Leader' at the TechEdu India Awards 2026, organised by ET Education; 'Entrepreneur of the Year 2025' at the ET Entrepreneur Awards by The Economic Times; 'the Distinguished Alumni Award (2023)' from IIT Bombay; 'EdTech CEO of the Year (2020)' from EdTechReview; and the P. N. Singh Memorial Award (2015) for 'Outstanding Academic Leadership' by the Higher Education Forum.

name: Nidhi Goyal
about: Ms Nidhi Goyal, COO at Tata Indian Institute of Skills, leverages over 20 years of experience in institution building and education. She led the establishment and launch of IIS Mumbai and Ahmedabad, developing high-quality, industry-aligned skilling programmes focused on workforce development. Her passion lies in developing practical pedagogical interventions for excellence in training.

name: Dr. Nidhi Pundhir
about: Dr. Nidhi Pundhir is an international humanitarian services and socio-economic-environmental development specialist. In the capacity of Senior Vice President, Global CSR, she leads the global CSR agenda for HCLTech and heads the HCLFoundation, which is the CSR arm of HCLTech, in India.  Dr. Pundhir has strategized as well as executed impactful programmatic frameworks that are aligned to the global Sustainable Development Goals, for the most disadvantaged and isolated communities, including environmental targets. She has a deep understanding of poverty issues and delivers realistic approaches towards poverty alleviation. In her current role, Nidhi has envisioned HCLTech’s flagship Global CSR Policy. She has built the HCLFoundation’s vision, mission, and strategy to the next level, ensuring high-quality programme delivery, that brings about meaningful difference on ground. With more than 27 years of experience in actualizing Human Rights and Environmental action at national and international levels, some of the key portfolios she has held were with SOS Children’s Villages as Director Programme Development, Asia, and at Plan International’s International Headquarters as Global Advisor on Child Protection in Development. Dr. Pundhir holds a doctorate in Public Health Management, with her thesis on “Right to Health During First 1000 Days of Life for Children Living in Slums”, from IIHMR University, Jaipur and an M.Phil. in Health Systems Management from BITS, Pilani, India.

name: Prateek Madhav
about: Prateek Madhav is the CEO and Co-Founder of AssisTech Foundation (ATF). Under his leadership, ATF has built the world’s largest ecosystem of over 500 Assistive Technology startups, positively impacting the lives of over 1 million people with disabilities. Prateek Madhav, CEO and Co-Founder of AssisTech Foundation (ATF), has built the world’s largest ecosystem of 500+ Assistive Technology startups, positively impacting over 1 million people with disabilities under his leadership.

name: Phani Sama
about:
Mr. Phanindra Sama is the Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of Deshpande Educational Trust. He is the founder of redBus, the world’s largest online bus ticketing company, as well as Subseq and Kakatiya Sandbox, a social impact venture based in his hometown of Nizamabad. He previously served the Government of Telangana as its Chief Innovation Officer and has been on the board of T-Works, India’s largest hardware prototyping centre.

Phani is a Young Global Leader of the World Economic Forum and has twice been named in Fortune’s “40 under 40” list. He holds a B.E. (Hons) with distinction from BITS Pilani, studied Responsible Leadership and Sustainable Business Practices at the Swedish Institute and Economics and Psychology at Stanford University, and is a Chevening Fellow of King’s College London.
designation: Chairperson of the Board of Trustees

name: Prashasti Rastogi
about: Prashasti Rastogi is Senior Director at Coursera India, where she leads digital transformation initiatives that close skill gaps, boost student employability, and expand lifelong learning access. With over 18 years across higher education, publishing, and technology, she advises governments and academic leaders on navigating the future of skilling. Her work has built strategic partnerships across APAC, Europe, and the US. She holds an MBA from FMS Delhi, Bachelor’s in Information Technology from University of Delhi, and EDP from IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Raj Gilda
about: Raj Gilda spent two decades in banking and IT in New York and Mumbai — Citibank, Deloitte, NSE, Tech Mahindra — quietly optimizing spreadsheets and, presumably, his own retirement plan. Then in 2011 he quit a perfectly good career to build vocational classrooms in government schools instead. As Co-founder at Lend A Hand India, he now works closely with state governments to bring vocational education into secondary schools, a scale of impact achieved in partnership with government, not by LAHI alone, now reaching 20+ states and over 2 million students a year. Along the way: a Chevening Gurukul Scholarship, a Government of India appointment to the National Skill Development Agency, a seat on NCERT's textbook development team under NEP 2020, a President's Volunteer Service Award, "top alumnus" honors from UT Austin (MBA included, presumably as a backup plan), and an Electronics Engineering degree from Pune which largely remains ornamental.

name: Ranjan Choudhury
about: Ranjan is a skill development professional with experience at NSDC, KK Modi Group and TCS iON. At NSDC, he spent over a decade leading initiatives in TVET, impact investments, CSR and WorldSkills India. Associated with WorldSkills since 2011, he has been an Honorary Member of WorldSkills International since 2020 and served as a member of the Secretariat at Lyon 2024 and Shanghai 2026. He has also served on Sector Skill Council Boards and the Advisory Board of SBI Foundation’s Centre of Excellence for Persons with Disabilities.

name: Rajiv Kumar Sharma
about: Rajiv Sharma is the Founder and Managing Director of Empower Pragati. He spent over 25 years in senior leadership roles across Kodak, HCL and Airtel Enterprise Services, where he served as CEO. A law graduate from Delhi University and an MBA from FMS, Delhi University, Rajiv moved from the corporate sector to the social sector after recognising the acute shortage of skilled, job-ready talent in India’s labour market. He founded Empower Pragati to help bridge this gap and has led it to become one of India’s most admired and innovative skill-training organisations. His leadership brings strategic direction, scale orientation and a strong industry-aligned approach to Empower’s work.

name: Rashmi Ranjan Mohapatra
about: Rashmi Ranjan Mohapatra, CEO of the World Skill Center (WSC), drives Odisha's skill development initiatives. Bringing over 30 years of industrial leadership, he spearheaded the establishment of 35 Centres of Excellence for Skill Development across India, impacting over 100,000 students and building a robust vocational ecosystem.
organisation: Odisha Skill Development Project II World Skill Center

name: Sanjeev Kumar Gupta
about: Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Gupta, ISS, is the Chief Executive Officer of the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM), with over 27 years of experience across government, entrepreneurship, and the technology industry. A topper of the 1998 Indian Statistical Service batch, he served in key roles in the Government of India before moving into leadership positions at IBM, Accenture, and Microsoft. He later led Lahari, a Government of India-promoted electronics manufacturing cluster in Mysuru. Since 2022, he has been driving Karnataka’s digital economy through initiatives spanning Global Capability Centres, IT/ITES, startups, electronics manufacturing, talent acceleration, and the Beyond Bengaluru initiative.

name: Dr. Suresh Bhojraj
about: Dr. B. Suresh Bhojraj is Pro-Chancellor of JSS University and JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research (JSS AHER), and Director of the Technical Education Division of JSS Mahavidyapeetha. Under his leadership, JSS institutions have become centres of excellence. He transformed pharmacy education in India by driving the introduction of the Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) programme, aligning it with global standards.
organisation: JSS Academy of Higher Education and Research, Mysuru

name: Uma Mahadevan
about: Uma Mahadevan is the Additional Chief Secretary and Development Commissioner in the Government of Karnataka. She has over 34 years' experience in diverse sectors at the state and central government. She has served on Government of India taskforces on service delivery and local governance. She writes regularly on development issues.
designation: Additional Chief Secretary and Development Commissioner

name: Vinay Kumar Swamy
about:
Vinay Kumar Swamy is an accomplished business leader and currently serves as the Country Head of Pearson India. With over two decades of experience, Vinay has firmly established himself as a dynamic executive with a profound understanding of the business landscape, customer needs, and organizational objectives. He plays a pivotal role in driving Pearson India's digital transformation and profitability, leveraging his extensive expertise in finance, corporate strategy, and mergers & acquisitions.

Prior to joining Pearson, Vinay held key roles at an investment banking firm and Clutch Group, where he honed his skills in finance, revenue growth strategies, and investor management. His diverse experience has equipped him with a comprehensive understanding of both financial and strategic business operations.

Vinay is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds a degree from Bangalore University, where he built a solid foundation in finance and business fundamentals.

name: Vinod Prabhu
about: Vinod Prabhu (IIM Bangalore MBA alumnus) is the Managing Director of Seventh Sense Talent Solutions, established in 2010, and Managing Trustee of WISER Foundation (with prior experience in Unilever and Deloitte). Focusing on providing skilling and placements to unemployed youth (in white/grey/blue-collar jobs), Seventh Sense and Wiser Foundation have partnered with 34 CSRs, 175+ hiring companies, and 452+ educational institutions. They currently train 2 lakh+ students and 40,000+ teachers, achieving 77% placement and retention annually across 23 states working closely with state and Central Governments
